team.title: Who we are
team.about: SofinWave is a focused team of senior engineers and consultants who have delivered production systems across fintech, e-commerce, and enterprise. We work as an extension of your team.

items.question: How do engagements start?
items.answer: With a short discovery call to understand your goals, followed by a written proposal and plan.

items.question: Do you work with existing teams?
items.answer: Yes. We frequently embed with in-house teams and hand off cleanly with documentation.

items.question: How is pricing structured?
items.answer: Fixed-scope for well-defined projects, or time-and-materials for evolving work. We agree it up front.

items.question: What about security and IP?
items.answer: You own all code and IP. We follow least-privilege access and can sign an NDA before we start.
